title: taxotrophis zeylanica
intro: Taxotrophis zeylanica, commonly known as Zeylanic tree or Indian fir, is a species of flowering plant in the family Pinaceae. This plant is reported to have various health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Taxotrophis zeylanica include its potential in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its bronchodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
